title: 9 Best Snorkeling Spots in Le Morne 2026
description: The best snorkeling spots in Le Morne, Mauritius — curated from Reddit reviews and local knowledge. Crystal Rock, Île aux Bénitiers, reef edges & more.

places.name: Le Morne Paradis Spot
places.address: Northern tip of Le Morne peninsula

redditQuotes.text: Le Morne beach is located on the northern side of the peninsula... in front of Le Paradis hotel at the very northern end. Incredible corals and fish — it's like snorkeling in an aquarium.

places.insiderTip: This is the spot everyone who's actually snorkeled Le Morne raves about. The walk keeps it uncrowded, the water clarity is absurd, and the reef is genuinely healthy with big coral formations. Worth every step. Bring reef shoes for the walk and your own snorkel kit.

places.name: Le Morne Public Beach

redditQuotes.text: Le Morne and Blue Bay are the two best snorkeling spots on the island. Le Morne public beach is the easy-access option on the northern side with decent corals and fish right offshore.
redditQuotes.source: r/mauritius · Best snorkeling in Mauritius thread

places.insiderTip: Your "base camp" for Le Morne snorkeling. Not quite as pristine as the Paradis Spot 20 minutes north, but the convenience, facilities, and solid reef life make it the smart choice for most visitors. Combine with a sunset dinner at one of the nearby restaurants.

places.name: Crystal Rock (Le Morne Lagoon)

redditQuotes.text: Crystal Rock is a must-visit. A fossilized coral formation that sits in the middle of the lagoon like a natural sculpture. The water around it is impossibly clear.

places.insiderTip: The single most photogenic snorkeling spot in all of Mauritius. The combination of the fossilized rock, crystal water, and Le Morne Brabant looming in the background is unreal. Book a morning boat trip for the best light and fewer boats.

places.name: Île aux Bénitiers

redditQuotes.text: Île aux Bénitiers is a popular day trip destination, and you're likely to find boats taking snorkelers to explore its vibrant reefs. We saw dolphins on the way out — incredible.
Encounter pods of spinner and bottlenose dolphins in the early morning, then snorkel the reefs around the island. The BBQ lunch is surprisingly good.
redditQuotes.source: travel site · Mauritius day trips guide

places.insiderTip: Best bang for your buck if you want the complete Le Morne marine experience — dolphins, healthy reefs, island vibes, and a BBQ lunch, all in one trip. Book the earliest departure (6–7 AM) for the best dolphin odds. Check operator reviews on TripAdvisor first.

places.name: La Prairie Beach
places.address: Between Le Morne & Baie du Cap

redditQuotes.text: La Prairie is a great spot for lazy snorkeling. The water is very shallow for a long distance out. You'll see cushion starfish scattered everywhere. Super quiet — we were the only ones there.

places.insiderTip: Not the flashiest reef life, but the most peaceful snorkeling on this list. The mountain backdrop rising directly above you while you float in waist-deep turquoise water is meditative. Ideal for a slow morning when you don't want to chase anything.

places.name: The Underwater Waterfall (Area)

redditQuotes.text: The underwater waterfall at Le Morne Brabant, Mauritius — it's an optical illusion caused by sand and silt being driven off the shelf. Absolutely surreal to see from above.

places.insiderTip: Manage expectations — this is more of an atmospheric experience than a great reef snorkel. You won't see the "waterfall" from water level. But the edge where shallow meets deep is genuinely eerie and beautiful, and the sand formations below are mesmerizing. Combine with a Crystal Rock stop on the same boat trip.

places.name: Le Morne Reef Edge
places.insiderTip: The best pure snorkeling on this list for experienced swimmers. The coral walls are the most impressive around Le Morne and the fish are bigger. But only go with a reputable boat operator who knows the currents — this isn't a swim-from-shore spot. Check conditions the morning of.

places.name: Macondé Point
places.address: South of Le Morne, coast road
places.insiderTip: The anti-tourist pick. Macondé rewards adventurous snorkelers with a rawer, more authentic experience. Check wave conditions before entering — exposed rocky coastline is unforgiving in swell. But on a calm day, the rock entry drops you into a mini aquarium. Pair with the scenic viewpoint nearby.

places.name: One Eye (Kite Beach Area)
places.insiderTip: Not the best snorkeling on this list, but the experience of floating in turquoise water with kites dancing above you and Le Morne Brabant towering overhead is uniquely Le Morne. Best as a sunset session — the mountain catches the golden light beautifully from this angle.
